lines.text: Line one hundred forty-three, initialize, runs once when the command starts.
With a fixed blue goal, line one hundred forty-six flips it for our alliance.
Why here? Line one hundred forty-five: the alliance isn't known yet when an OpMode is built.
On red, x becomes field length minus x, y becomes field width minus y, and the heading turns half a circle.
Line one hundred forty-seven swaps in a supplier that always returns that goal, so execute only calls goal.
Lines one hundred forty-eight to one hundred fifty: with a next waypoint, run the corner rule from the robot's current pose.
Line one hundred fifty-two matters most: commanded starts as the robot's measured velocity.
Already rolling at two meters per second? The limiter starts from two, not zero: no jump, no slipping wheels.
Then start the clock, and reset distance and heading error: not there yet.
